name: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Line an 8x8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Combine sugar, milk, and salt in a saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil exactly 2.5 minutes without stirring.
Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter, vanilla, and butter until smooth.
Quickly pour into prepared pan and spread evenly.
Let set at room temperature 2 hours or refrigerate 1 hour.
Lift out using parchment and cut into small squares.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use oat milk and dairy-free butter.
substitutions.vegan: Use plant milk and vegan butter.

notes: Move fast once off the heat — it sets quickly. Have your pan ready before you start.
